page.layout: One page of text, one column; a dedicatory address with a title block at the top, a large woodcut initial at the start of the paragraph, and a signature block at the foot. No margin notes.

main_text.head: Reverendissimo Patri in Christo JONATHANI Episcopo Exoniensi.
main_text.p: QUod in publicum commodum hic meditatus sum, id inprimis grati animi existere volui erga Te indicium pro iis, quæ tam ubertim in meconferre dignatus es, meritis. Nec dubitare me sinit Tuum liberale in iis collocandis ingenium, quin candido id accepturus sis animo, quamvis vilis sit nimium eorundem hæc mea recognitio. Res est utique omnium Christianorum benevolentia digna, quippe ea, quam hic offero, Prophetia, peculiari modo nobis suggerit mirandam illam Spiritus Sancti effusionem, exactamque gratiarum ac donorum ejus collationem; quæ temporibus Christi futura erat, atque a S. Petro allegatur in ejus adventus promissorumque a Deo præstitorum argumentum. Nonpaucis hic Propheta difficultatum implicitus est nodis, quos uti resolvere omni nisu contendi, ita, ut conatus meos qualescunque habeas acceptos, veniaque, si quid cespitatum fuerit, digneris summo peto opere,

page.notes: The woodcut initial Q is joined to "Uod" as "QUod". The red ink stamp at the lower right is a library stamp and is omitted. Some words are doubtful: "meconferre" and "quasi" readings are as printed; "veniaque" and "peto" are as printed. The line "Nonpaucis" is printed as one word.
